## MacOSKeychainKeyProvider.getPrivateKey() method

Get the private key from keychain for signing. Downloads to a temporary file and returns a cleanup function.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getPrivateKey(keyRef: string): Promise<KeyRetrievalResult>;
```
